quotes.excerpt: > are any of the Chinese frontier models available on neutral infrastructure? Yup, Check out Openrouter providers for your particular chinese frontier model/ open weights model in general and you could find the location of all providers who host that model and where they are hosted (US/EU countries etc.) as well. You can also change Claude font as others are mentioning.
